description.en: The foundational principles of Warren Buffett's investment philosophy
description.zh: 沃伦·巴菲特投资哲学的基础原则

definition.en: Buy at a significant discount to intrinsic value to protect against errors and unforeseen events
definition.zh: 以显著低于内在价值的价格买入，以防止错误和不可预见事件的影响

buffett_quote.en: The three most important words in investing are margin of safety.
buffett_quote.zh: 投资中最重要的三个词是安全边际。

key_points: Never pay full price for an asset
Leave room for mistakes in analysis
The larger the margin, the safer the investment

definition.en: Invest only in businesses you truly understand; know the boundaries of your knowledge
definition.zh: 只投资你真正理解的企业；清楚自己知识的边界

buffett_quote.en: Risk comes from not knowing what you're doing.
buffett_quote.zh: 风险来自于不知道自己在做什么。

key_points: Define what you know and what you don't know
Stay within your circle of competence
It's not how big the circle is, it's how well you know the boundary
Better to be approximately right than precisely wrong

definition.en: View the market as an emotional partner who offers prices daily - sometimes rational, sometimes not
definition.zh: 将市场视为一个情绪化的伙伴，每天提供报价——有时理性，有时不理性

buffett_quote.en: Be fearful when others are greedy and greedy when others are fearful.
buffett_quote.zh: 别人贪婪时我恐惧，别人恐惧时我贪婪。

key_points: The market is there to serve you, not to guide you
Market prices are often disconnected from value
Take advantage of market mood swings
Don't let the market's emotions become your emotions

definition.en: The true value of a business based on its future cash flows, not its market price
definition.zh: 基于未来现金流的企业真实价值，而非市场价格

buffett_quote.en: Intrinsic value is an estimate rather than a precise figure... it is the discounted value of the cash that can be taken out of a business during its remaining life.
buffett_quote.zh: 内在价值是一个估计值而非精确数字……它是企业剩余寿命期间可以提取的现金的折现值。

key_points: Focus on cash generation, not accounting earnings
Value is independent of market price
Different analysts may reach different estimates

definition.en: Net income plus depreciation/amortization minus maintenance capex
definition.zh: 净利润加上折旧/摊销减去维护性资本支出

supporting_concepts.formula: Owner Earnings = Net Income + D&A - Maintenance CapEx

buffett_quote.en: Owner earnings... represent the cash flow that a business could distribute to owners if it decided to forego all growth.
buffett_quote.zh: 所有者收益……代表企业如果决定放弃所有增长，可以分配给所有者的现金流。

definition.en: Sustainable competitive advantage that protects a business from competition
definition.zh: 保护企业免受竞争的可持续竞争优势

buffett_quote.en: A truly great business must have an enduring 'moat' that protects the high return on invested capital.
buffett_quote.zh: 一个真正伟大的企业必须拥有持久的'护城河'来保护高投资回报率。

evolution.early_years: Learned from Ben Graham: focus on quantitative metrics, net-nets, cigar butts
evolution.middle_period: Influenced by Charlie Munger: shift to quality businesses at fair prices
evolution.mature_approach: Buy wonderful companies at fair prices and hold forever

sources: The Intelligent Investor by Benjamin Graham
Security Analysis by Graham and Dodd
